en: Sepia-toned historical postcard showing a cobblestoned market square framed by two‑ and three‑storey buildings. In the center background stands an ornate, towered brick building that appears to be the town hall, with simpler residential or commercial houses on both sides. Small figures walk or stand around the open square where some goods or carts are visible. Printed captions at the bottom read the town name and indicate that this is the marketplace.
